findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "find_walk_in_places" is 3381 chars, far longer than this server's median (457). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Find businesses that take walk-ins, by US city, near a point, by the business's name or by ZIP code, with how long the wait is right now. Open places come first…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_walk_in_places, get_place · Private data: check_my_place_in_line · Public sink: get_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_walk_in_places, get_place · Private data: check_my_place_in_line · Public sink: get_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_walk_in_places" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
